recent_en: Avillion is undertaking a capital restructuring involving capital reduction, share consolidation, rights issue and an exemption from a mandatory general offer, with an EGM set for 11 December 2026 to seek shareholder approval. The company is also in a lease dispute with an alleged landowner over a Bali resort, involving about RM11.2 million. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 31% QoQ but fell 18.6% YoY, with a net loss of RM3.096 million.
notable_en: Proposed capital restructuring comprising capital reduction, share consolidation, rights issue and exemption from mandatory general offer, to be tabled at the EGM on 11 December 2026.
Independent adviser Alliance Islamic Bank considers the proposed exemption from mandatory general offer fair and reasonable.
Lease dispute with an alleged landowner over a Bali resort, involving about RM11.2 million.
risks_en: Proposed rights issue and capital restructuring may result in shareholding dilution.
Dispute with an alleged landowner over the Bali resort lease, involving about RM11.2 million.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM3.096 million with revenue down 18.6% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM13.736 million, up 31.0% QoQ but down 18.6% YoY; net loss was RM3.096 million with a net margin of -22.5%, narrowing from -54.1% in the previous quarter.
